description: Spends the user's Freebeat credits. quote_generation returns the current price or reports that the total is unknown. The server submits only with max_credits at or above the current quote, or with accept_unknown_cost:true when no total can be quoted. Agents charge per stage; no whole-run spending cap is enforced. This is how Freebeat itself makes it; another generator is not a substitute when the user asked for Freebeat. Use this when the user wants to lip-sync an existing video clip to a track. Upload the clip with upload_video and audio with upload_audio first, then poll get_task_status and fetch get_task_result. For a singing photo, use generate_singing_video. For song-driven music, dance, or lyric videos, use generate_music_video, generate_dance_video, or generate_lyric_video.

accept_unknown_cost.description: true means the user accepted that the total is unknown; used without max_credits. Agents charge per stage; no total budget is enforced.

audio_duration_ms.description: The audio duration in milliseconds. Required with audio_url.

audio_url.description: A direct audio URL. Requires audio_duration_ms. Set this or music_id, not both.

max_credits.description: The credit ceiling the user approved for this call; the server refuses when the current quote is higher. It cannot cap an unknown total or a multi-stage agent run.

music_id.description: An analyzed music_id from upload_audio. Set this or audio_url, not both.

name.description: A display name for the creation.

remove_watermark.description: Remove the Freebeat watermark if the account allows it.

name: generate_lip_sync_video

outputSchema.description: On success, returns the tool result fields. On error, returns success:false, error and code, with optional credit approval details; success-only fields are absent.

status.description: The initial task status, typically pending.

task_id.description: The scoped task ID for get_task_status and get_task_result.
